content: {"episode_id":"ep-05010","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and unspecified atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management."}
